name: Ohmywishes Button
author: Ohmywishes

sections.description:
The Ohmywishes Button plugin is the fastest way to get to your customers’ wishlists. Hold on to those who are not ready to complete a purchase right away, and attract more customers.

The button will appear on each product page in the location you choose. By clicking on the button, a visitor to your website will be able to add the product they are viewing to their wishlist on Ohmywishes.

Basic features

  • compatible with WooCommerce
  • visual button editor with live preview
  • choose between text, an icon, or a combination
  • configure dimensions and colors
  • add additional styles
  • place buttons in various places in the template for your online store
  • display buttons on products only in the relevant language, if you use WPML.

External services

The plugin uses external services: it loads executable JavaScript code from Ohmywishes. This happens when the page is loaded into the browser. During this process, the browser sends technical information (IP address, User-Agent, HTTP headers) to the service. This is necessary to correctly load the script that allows the button to work.

  • Ohmywishes Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
Install via the WordPress dashboard:

  1. Log in to the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to “Plugins” → “Add New”.
  3. In the search field, type “Ohmywishes Button” and click “Install”.
  4. After installation, click “Activate”.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress website.
  2. In the WordPress admin panel, go to “Plugins” → “Add New” → “Upload Plugin”.
  3. Select the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install”.
  4. After installation, click “Activate”.
sections.faq:
Why doesn’t the button display on the site?

This could be related to caching. Try the following:

  • clear your browser’s cache
  • clear the cache of WordPress cache plugins
  • clear the cache at the level of your hosting provider (e.g. Cloudflare)
  • temporarily disable the site’s caching for testing purposes.

The button is right next to other elements.

Make sure you added top and bottom offsets in the advanced settings.

Is it possible to use multiple sets of buttons?

Only one button design can be installed on the same site.

Is the plugin compatible with a multi-site installation of WordPress?

Yes, but we recommend activating the plugin on each site separately rather than the entire network.

Does the plugin make a site run slower?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for high performance.
